description: This file defines an abstract class 'Entry' within the 'Todaymade\Daux\Tree' namespace. The class models a generic entry in a hierarchical tree structure, likely representing documentation or a file system entity, with properties like title, name, URI, parent directory, file info, and path. It provides methods for managing these properties, retrieving related information, and navigating the tree hierarchy.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Abstract class representing a generic hierarchical entry with properties for title, name, URI, parent directory, file info, and path, along with methods for property management and tree navigation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Entry with a parent Directory, URI, and optional file info, setting up properties and adding the entry to the parent's children.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entry.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the entry.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI of the entry.

methods.name: setUri
methods.description: Sets the URI of the entry and updates the parent's children accordingly.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the entry.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the entry.

methods.name: getNameForSort
methods.description: Provides a fallback string for sorting, prioritizing name, title, then URI.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent Directory of the entry.

methods.name: getParents
methods.description: Returns an array of all parent directories up to the root.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the relative or absolute file path of the entry.

methods.name: getRelativePath
methods.description: Returns the path relative to the root directory.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the full URL path by concatenating parent URLs and its URI.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns an array representation of the entry's key properties.

methods.name: isHotPath
methods.description: Determines if the current entry is on a hot path based on its parent.
